body:
## What to build

Reject duplicate grouping-set occurrences that a Cartesian product's resolved prefix already makes unavoidable, before resolving a later family with multiple grouping sets. Apply this to inspection and both Nest verbs under the duplicate-error policy.

On fetched main `0403c9150394cbae21b59f34c75791d0873b8451`, the first product factor was a union of the same singleton set twice. The second factor was a union of one typed-selection grouping set and the empty grouping set. Each suffix branch necessarily produced one set, so product occurrences 1 and 3 were duplicates and occurrences 2 and 4 were duplicates regardless of the selector's answer.

Nevertheless, on a two-column local input all three consumers invoked the caller's predicate twice before rejecting those duplicates. An unsafe derived dtplyr input instead produced the metadata-safety refusal, displacing the locally decidable duplicate error. Live DuckDB inspection issued one actual zero-row metadata statement before the duplicate refusal, independently observed at the DBI boundary. A singleton typed suffix and a two-set literal suffix both rejected without predicate evaluation or metadata statements. These controls separated the failure from ordinary type-dependent duplicate detection.

ADR 0005 orders locally decidable errors before metadata acquisition. ADR 0008 retains completed nested-family checks before later selections. #1266, #1305, and PR #1340 repaired related prefix cases with single-set remaining factors; this witness has a provably duplicate prefix followed by a two-set suffix. The 21-case boundary matrix contained 14 successful controls and seven failures: three local callback cases, three dtplyr diagnostic replacements, and the DuckDB metadata statement.

Reproduced with R 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1, dtplyr 1.3.3, DuckDB 1.5.5, and tidyselect 1.2.1 on macOS arm64. Product expansion with allowed duplicate policies was separately covered by an independent finite algebra oracle.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inspection and both Nest verbs reject the provable duplicate product before evaluating the typed selector or acquiring typed metadata.
- [ ] Unsafe dtplyr input receives the duplicate diagnostic without executing its upstream callback; DuckDB inspection sends no metadata statement for this invalid request.
- [ ] Retain the singleton-suffix and literal-family controls and report the duplicate occurrences consistently with the resolved Grouping plan.
- [ ] Valid nonduplicate products and allowed duplicate-drop/keep behavior retain grouping-set membership, order, and Grouping identifiers; nesting continues to offer only its documented policies.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately). This repair is independent of the full-join metadata finding from the same investigation.

comments.body: The dated reproduction, controls, duplicate-search disposition and independent replay are recorded in [investigation PR #1348](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1348). This PR records evidence only; the repair remains in this implementation ticket.

title: [P2] Reject provable product duplicates before resolving a multi-set suffix
